allow_instructions: Development commands using pnpm in this repository are safe to run without asking for approval.
Read-only git commands such as git status and git diff are safe to run without asking for approval.
block_instructions: Always ask for approval before deleting files or directories.
Always ask for approval before running git reset, git clean, git checkout, git restore, or git push.
Always ask for approval before running database migrations or destructive database commands.
